fallible prior, but must not contradict supplied sources or present inferred
details as externally verified. Produce diverse, mutation-friendly seed
sequences and return JSON only.

This file contains standardized BACnet protocol operation identifiers:

The values marked RESERVED must not be interpreted as currently defined
standard operations.

================================================================
1. BACnet APDU PDU TYPE
================================================================

The APDU type is stored in the high nibble of the first APDU octet.

0x00 = Confirmed-Request-PDU
0x10 = Unconfirmed-Request-PDU
0x20 = SimpleACK-PDU
0x30 = ComplexACK-PDU
0x40 = SegmentACK-PDU
0x50 = Error-PDU
0x60 = Reject-PDU
0x70 = Abort-PDU

PDU type numeric value before shifting:

0 = Confirmed-Request-PDU
1 = Unconfirmed-Request-PDU
2 = SimpleACK-PDU
3 = ComplexACK-PDU
4 = SegmentACK-PDU
5 = Error-PDU
6 = Reject-PDU
7 = Abort-PDU

[SOURCE id=issue:1270:1270-summary:f10b3cba62a1 kind=issue issue=1270 path=distilled_issue/1.BACnet-stack/#1270.txt]
Issue: 1270
Summary: In v1.3.1, the report says a malformed UCOV/property-value payload can make bacapp_decode_application_data() accept an oversized extended application length without checking it against the remaining APDU bytes. That unchecked length is then propagated through bacapp_decode_data() into host_n_port_decode(), which trusts it, and bacnet_tag_number_decode() eventually performs an invalid read and crashes. The observed result was an AddressSanitizer SEGV; GDB showed apdu_len_max=12, tag_len=7, len_value_type=0xFF210121, and tag_data_type=34 (BACNET_APPLICATION_TAG_HOST_N_PORT).
Reproduce: 1) Use v1.3.1. 2) Decode a malformed UCOV/property-value payload whose extended application length exceeds the remaining APDU bytes; the reported bytes near the triggering boundary were: f5 22 ff ff 21 01 21 0e 2d ff 00 e6. 3) In the failing case, GDB showed apdu_len_max=12, tag_len=7, len_value_type=0xFF210121, and tag_data_type=34 (BACNET_APPLICATION_TAG_HOST_N_PORT). 4) Expected result: the oversized length is accepted by bacapp_decode_application_data(), passed via bacapp_decode_data() into host_n_port_decode(), and bacnet_tag_number_decode() hits an invalid read, with AddressSanitizer reporting SEGV on an unknown address 0x641f9505e92e (pc 0x641f93a5ffdd bp 0x7ffeab919b70 sp 0x7ffeab919b50 T0).
[/SOURCE]

[SOURCE id=issue:1304:1304-summary:e1e381ed7daa kind=issue issue=1304 path=distilled_issue/1.BACnet-stack/#1304.txt]
Issue: 1304
Summary: In bacnet-stack 1.4.2, a crafted BACnet/IP WritePropertyMultiple packet sequence can trigger an out-of-bounds read in the decode path. The report says wpm_decode_object_property(), while parsing the optional priority field (tag 3), trusts len_value and calls decode_unsigned() even when it exceeds the bytes remaining in the current sub-buffer (example given: len_value 4 with only 3 bytes left), so it can return a length larger than its apdu_len; write_property_multiple_decode() then adds that length to its offset without checking that it still fits in the remaining input, underflowing the later length calculation and propagating invalid state into bacnet_enclosed_data_length()/bacnet_tag_decode(). The observed result is an AddressSanitizer global-buffer-overflow read in bacnet_tag_number_decode() and a crash from reading past the receive buffer; the reporter additionally says this appears to be a remotely reachable denial of service.
Reproduce: Use the unmodified server-side code path in bacnet-stack 1.4.2 that handles WritePropertyMultiple. Send these BACnet/IP UDP packets in order:
1. <81><0b><00><19><01><20><ff><ff><00><ff><10><00><c4><02><00><03><e8><22><05><c4><91><03><22><01><04>
2. <81><0a><30><30><01><04><00><00><30><10><00><0d><40><30><30><1e><03><00><01><9e><2e><30><30><2f><3c><01><30><2e>
3. Repeat packet 1.
4. Repeat packet 2.
Expected result: the WritePropertyMultiple decode path reads past the end of the receive buffer and the server crashes. In the reporter's tests, AddressSanitizer reported "ERROR: AddressSanitizer: global-buffer-overflow" and "READ of size 1", with the fault in bacnet_tag_number_decode().
[/SOURCE]
